The *Parittattika* ("Triad on the Limited" or "Lesser Triad") is the thirteenth section of the first division of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭṭhaka [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language for this text [SuttaCentral].
No curated cross-canonical parallels are listed for the text on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus reveals extensive internal reuse within the Pali canon, recording 18,536 matching passages shared with 97 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The highest volumes of shared formulaic material occur with other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, most notably the *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13), the *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 2.10), the *Kusalattika* (Patthana 1.2), and the *Hetugocchaka* (Patthana 2.1) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus aligns individual segments of the *Parittattika* with several Sanskrit and Tibetan scholastic works, including Ghoṣaka's *Abhidharmāmṛta*, Vimalamitra's *Vibhāṣāprabhāvṛtti*, the *Mahāvyutpatti*, and Tibetan versions of the *Yogācārabhūmi* (D4035), the *Āryākṣayamatinirdeśaṭīkā* (D3994), the *Abhidharmasamuccaya* (D4049), and the *Abhidharmakośabhāṣya* (D4090) [DharmaNexus].
